gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2526 experienced a significant gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 31.7 million in 2014, representing 30.31% of its opening gross reserves. This adverse development was attributed to numerous and complex factors, including later claims development on more recent years of account, particularly the primary PI book, which saw a GBP 17.0 million increase in ultimate gross claims. Specific deteriorations included GBP 4.0 million in the PI excess of loss account and GBP 6.8 million in D&O, the latter linked to a London market MGA. The overall claims deterioration was also linked to years impacted by the Global Credit Crunch and ensuing detrimental economic conditions. The syndicate also noted adverse claims development on prior years for the primary element of the PI book.
